title: Suitability of MTBE-blended Al-Daura catalytic reformate as a finished gasoline: data, open-source models and Aspen HYSYS cases
description: Version 2.0 replaces the manual HYSYS workflow of version 1.0 with an open-source Python workflow: surrogate fitting to the measured D86 curve, RVP and density; MTBE vapour pressure with NRTL parameters fitted to binary VLE data; a D86 batch-distillation model with reflux calibrated on measured MTBE blends; Monte Carlo octane bounds; MTBE blending windows; figures and tables. The version 1.0 HYSYS cases and results are kept in cases/hysys and data/raw.
